title: Power Shift
author: Sandra Colhando
description:
Welcome to Power Shift. A podcast hosted by Sandra Colhando — executive coach and co-founder of TransforMe Learning & Leadership Solutions. She has spent decades working with women navigating the most complex and least-talked-about phase of professional life. Season 1 is built around a single theme: The Inflection Point. Women who faced a moment that changed everything, and how they pivoted.

This show exists because there's almost no content built specifically for women in their 40s who are still building. Not winding down. Not ascending. Standing tall in the middle of a career that has 20 more years in it — grappling with fears and identity questions that most leadership content, still largely built around men, doesn't know how to address.

The 43-year-old CHRO wondering if the rules she played by still apply. The senior leader who was passed over and is figuring out what comes next. The founder who left corporate in her 40s and is still making sense of what that cost and what it gave her. The one who chose motherhood in her 40s while navigating a leadership role. This show is built for them.

Sandra isn't an outsider to this conversation. She's walked this road herself, and alongside hundreds of women she's coached. She doesn't interview — she becomes a confidante.

Subscribe to catch every conversation.

title: The Joe Jaap Podcast
author: Joseph Jaap
description:
There has to be a better way to build.


The Joe Jaap Podcast is about the people, decisions, lessons, and ideas that shape meaningful growth in business and in life.


Hosted by 22-year entrepreneur Joe Jaap, founder of EmoryDay, the show brings together honest conversations, hard-earned experience, practical thinking, and a genuine curiosity about what helps people move forward.

Some episodes may explore business growth, leadership, marketing, AI, sales, or the systems that help companies scale. Others may go somewhere less expected: risk, ambition, resilience, money, relationships, opportunity, failure, confidence, reinvention, or the moments that change how we see ourselves and what we are capable of building.


Because behind every company, strategy, and decision are people.

People trying to make good choices with incomplete information. People carrying responsibility for employees, customers, families, and futures. People learning when to push harder, when to change direction, when to trust their instincts, and when to take the next step before they feel completely ready.


Joe draws from more than two decades as an entrepreneur and from conversations with builders, leaders, thinkers, and operators who have learned something worth sharing along the way.


There are no formulas for a perfect business or a perfect life. But there are better questions, useful principles, meaningful stories, and lessons we can carry into whatever comes next.


No hype. No shallow tactics. No pretending the road is easier than it is.

Just thoughtful conversations for people who want to build something meaningful, keep growing, and make the most of the opportunities in front of them.


Growth Can Be Crafted.


Produced by EmoryDay. New episodes weekly.

title: Groundwork: The Art & Craft of Utah Custom Homes
author: Pete Codella
description:
Groundwork: The Art & Craft of Utah Custom Homes
Building a custom home along Utah’s Wasatch Front is an extraordinary experience, but turning a vision from raw dirt into a legacy estate takes far more than just blueprints. It takes real groundwork.
Welcome to Groundwork: The Art and Craft of Utah Custom Homes, the podcast that demystifies the entire custom homebuilding and residential development journey. Hosted by Pete Codella, chief marketing officer at Gordon Milar Construction, this series pulls back the curtain on high-end residential construction across Northern Utah.
Whether you’re dreaming of building your first custom home, actively planning a mountainside build, exploring property and lot development, or working as an artisan trade professional passionate about the craft, this show is built for you.
What You’ll Discover Inside Each Episode
Custom homebuilding can often feel daunting, complex, and full of hidden surprises. In Groundwork, we replace guesswork with transparency, actionable insights, and master-level trade knowledge:
- Site Selection & Complex Topography: Understand how heavy civil excavation, slope engineering, soil conditions, freeze-thaw frost lines, and lot grading protect your home's foundation and maximize panoramic Wasatch mountain views.
- Architecture & Spatial Design: Learn how top architects, drafters, and interior designers translate a family’s lifestyle into functional floor plans, tailored spaces, and timeless aesthetics.
- The Invisible Building Science: Explore the modern technology behind the sheetrock, from pre-drywall 3D digital-twin scanning and advanced framing to smart electrical routing and high-performance building envelopes.
- Artisan Craftsmanship & Custom Finishes: Go behind the scenes with master woodworkers, stone masons, finish carpenters, and design innovators to discover the details that define true quiet luxury.
- Value Engineering & Smart Planning: Learn proven strategies for navigating municipal permitting, establishing detailed specifications, making finish selections without stress, and keeping project budgets aligned.
Decades of Real Wasatch Front Experience
Rooted in over 50 years of Utah homebuilding history, Groundwork is built on the belief that enduring homes start with enduring relationships. Gordon Milar Construction has spent decades shaping Northern Utah’s residential landscape by collaborating hand in hand with the region’s finest subcontractors, artisan trades, engineers, and financial leaders.
In each episode, GMC's Chief Marketing Officer, Pete Codella, sits down with these very experts, the craftspeople, builders, designers, and project leaders who make Utah’s most impressive homes a reality. You'll hear firsthand stories, lessons learned from real job sites, practical building advice, and the essential questions every prospective homeowner should ask before breaking ground.
From lot acquisition and foundation pours to four-way walkthroughs and the day you receive your keys, building a custom home should be an inspiring collaboration.
Subscribe to Groundwork: The Art and Craft of Utah Custom Homes on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you listen to podcasts, and let’s dig in.
Connect with us at gmilar.com or follow @GordonMilarConstruction.

Discover the science behind hypochlorous acid (HOCl), a molecule naturally produced by the immune system, and its applications in dentistry, wound care, dermatology, eye care, infection control, inflammation, cleaning, inhalation research, and more. 
Explore the evidence, current uses, and future potential of this remarkable molecule.

Season 2, Running Anyway, turns the lens personal: what does a city ask of the women who move through it? Built from research and real conversations with women who run in Rotterdam.

Ten Leaders. One Question.

Bonus conversations every Thursday.

description:
A survivor-led podcast exploring domestic abuse, recovery and the prevention of violence against women and girls through original audio drama, music, creative storytelling and conversations with professionals.
Created by Workie Ticket Theatre and developed from JoJo Kirtley’s Churchill Fellowship research into how theatre can empower survivors and challenge gender-based violence.

A behind-the-curtain conversation on mind mastery and Freedom Reimagined.

Dave is a music producer, Hope runs a charity supporting victims of trafficking, and together they bring honest conversations about relationships, parenting, culture, current affairs, faith, and everything in between. THE STOIC ANSWER brings practical Stoicism to modern life. Explore how Stoic wisdom can help with overthinking, difficult people, regret, relationships, money, uncertainty, self-control, and everyday stress.
Each episode turns the timeless ideas of Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, and Seneca into clear, practical guidance you can use today.
Think more clearly. Respond better. Focus on what you can control.
Based on THE STOIC ANSWER book series by Julian Mercer.

description: Wild Earth, your ultimate masterclass for exploring the raw majesty, hidden complexities, and intricate webs of the natural world. Hosted by wildlife enthusiasts and environmental storytellers, we cut through dry academic jargon to bring you riveting tales of animal behavior, ecosystem dynamics, and the breathtaking survival strategies of life on Earth. Whether you're an avid conservationist, a wildlife lover, or simply someone who wants to escape the concrete jungle and reconnect with the wild, we've got the exact stories and breakdowns you need.

title: Bengals Brothers
author: Jim
description: Welcome to Bengal Brothers — where die-hard Bengals fans from the great state of Ohio come together to talk stripes, wins, and everything in between. We’re lifelong Cincinnati Bengals faithful breaking down every game, draft pick, and headline. Whether it's postgame reactions, in-depth analysis, or hot takes on the latest news from the Jungle, we’ve got you covered. No fluff — just pure Bengals talk from fans who bleed orange and black. Join us weekly as we ride the highs, weather the lows, and stay loyal to the stripes.

Welcome to Previously On with Will.
Reality TV had a week, celebrity news did what celebrity news does, and honestly… somebody needs to talk about it.
This is the place for recaps, reunion mess, cast drama, pop culture headlines, production edits, and the moments the group chat cannot stop discussing.
The episode may be over, but the conversation starts here.

title: Good Dirt: Southern Farmers and their Search For Land
author: Chapin Montague and Mattie Sienknecht
description: Join Chapin and Mattie as they begin their journey across the Southeast and talk to farmers about their unique land access stories. Available and affordable land is the number one obstacle for farmers today. We wanted to know what options are available to young and emerging farmers in the region and what obstacles are standing in their way.

title: Chronic & Iconic
author: Nicola Nicholls and Lisa McCann
description:
Welcome to Chronic and Iconic, the podcast 

Two girls with one diagnosis of Juvenile Rheumatoid Arthritis. We’re not here to be inspirational, we’re raw, gritty, unhinged and unapologetically living life to the fullest. 

Join us for episodes of laughter, trauma we can laugh at, careers, marriage, kids, divorce and dating in our 40’s.

Hold tight, it’s gonna be a ride!


Join us on Instagram: @chronicandiconic.podcast

Media enquiries: chronicandiconicpodcast@gmail.com

title: First and Hard 10
author: First.and.hard.10
description: First & Hard 10 is a sports and betting podcast with Matt, Dave, and Billy. Three friends bringing their own takes on football, baseball, golf, and the games they love. Plus weekly picks, parlays, plenty of debate, and stories from the craps table. We celebrate the wins, own the losses, and have a good time along the way. Sports. Bets. Action.

title: The Wabash Inn Mess
author: Wade Gish
description: Taking it's title from the specialty book store of the same name, The Wabash Inn Mess podcast is a collaboration between three friends with a common passion for the American Civil War. The hosts maintain the belief that there are three methods to most effectively understand the military aspects of the conflict: Research, Re-creation, and Gaming. Veteran Civil War living historians Chuck Warnick, Norris Darrall, and Wade Gish will devote a portion of each episode to all three methods to help you find and sharpen the tools needed to understand the events of 1861-65, both momentous and mundane.

title: The Director's Cut: From the Office for the Mission of Catholic Education
author: EliasJMoo
description: The Director’s Cut: From the Office for the Mission of Catholic Education is a podcast for Catholic School Pastors, leaders, and all those committed Catholic education in the Archdiocese of Portland in Oregon. Each episode offers updates from the Office for the Mission of Catholic Education, reflections on mission and leadership, and seeks to help pastors and leaders stay connected, think deeply, and lead Mission Passionate Catholic Education in the Archdiocese of Portland in Oregon.

title: Turf to Table
author: Lucas and Gianni
description: Horrible Sports Takes, Great Vibes, looking to connect with the community all while having tons of fun. Ball out.

author: Escape Collective
description:
A podcast about the founders, the innovators, and the remarkable people in the cycling industry and the stories about the icons they've created.

Escape Collective is member-funded. If you like this podcast please consider supporting us by becoming a member: https://escapecollective.com/overnightsuccess/

title: The Creative Executive
author: The Creative Executive
description:
Where creatives come to master the business of their art. 

The Creative Executive is a show built for the modern creative economy, where artists are becoming founders, executives are becoming storytellers, technology is reshaping every industry, and the people with the greatest ideas often lack the mentorship and business fluency to move those ideas through the world. The show brings together leaders from entertainment, entrepreneurship, technology, and culture to unpack how they built what they built, what they learned, what they got wrong, and what it takes to manifest the life and career their talent was made for. 

Hosted by Harry Smith and Siddhi Sundar. Launching October 7, 2026

title: Far From Perfect
author: Upatree & Harstem
description: Join Sal and Kevin on Far From Perfect, a podcast where gaming, sports, road trips, and everyday life all find their way into the conversation. From StarCraft and BlizzCon to Olympic headlines, bathroom renovations, and bears in Canada, there’s no telling where each episode will go. Two friends, plenty of tangents, and some very questionable definitions of “heavy-hitting topics.”

title: AI & The Boardroom
author: Jean Dorff
description:
AI is changing the business environment. It is not replacing the fundamentals of strategy, leadership, or judgment.

AI & The Boardroom explores what AI changes, what it doesn’t, and what leaders need to decide.

The show is for CEOs, business owners, executives, directors, and leaders responsible for strategy, growth, organizational development, and adaptation.

Each episode looks beyond the tools and the hype to examine the business questions underneath: competition, differentiation, efficiency, risk, decision-making, organizational behavior, and how to lead when technology is moving faster than companies can fully absorb it.

Because the challenge is not simply whether to adopt AI.

It is knowing where it belongs, where it does not, what deserves attention now, and what should remain unchanged.

AI & The Boardroom is hosted by Jean Dorff of Jean Dorff Consultancy.

description: Luke Wileman, Steven Caldwell and Kevin Kilbane get stuck into the biggest football stories from around the world—with sharp analysis, big opinions and plenty of banter. 🚌⚽

description: Welcome to The History Hyat! We’re talking about bad life choices, ridiculous rivalries, and moments that make you realize humanity has always been a hot mess.Whether you’re commuting, doing dishes, or actively avoiding your responsibilities, grab your favorite drink and get ready to laugh. By the end of it we're going to find out who performs under pressure! After each show we sit down with the competitor for a interview and you can get to know them a little more!

Real Jesus with Natalie Burdick is a podcast about real life, real faith, and the real Jesus who meets us in the middle.

You don't need a perfect life or all the right answers, just a willingness to meet Jesus where you are.

Motherhood isn’t always pretty—and we’re talking about ALL of it. 🎙️💕

author: Newcastle Cathedral
description:
Inspired by the Cathedral’s Lantern Tower, which once guided ships safely along the Tyne, this new series of videos from Newcastle Cathedral features conversations with amazing local groups and organisations working alongside people navigating difficult circumstances in life.
We're very grateful to our various grant funders for making this series, and the wider work of the Cathedral Lantern Project, possible. 
Find out more: https://newcastlecathedral.org.uk/lantern-project/

title: Vibrating Vaginas
author: Jessika Ondrick & Tiffany Mairs
description: Vibrating Vaginas is the funny, curious, and unfiltered podcast about women’s bodies, aging, menopause, hormones, relationships, sexuality, nervous system health, and the things nobody warned us about. Soul Sisters Jessika Ondrick & Tiffany Mairs bring real conversations, ridiculous laughter, personal stories, and practical tools to the messy, magical experience of feeling good in your body and your life at every age.

description: Each week, Asmongold and his co-host, Rich Campbell, will interview guests across the digital, political, and cultural spheres, tackling the internet’s biggest stories. Episodes will release on Asmongold’s YouTube channel and air weekly throughout the year, featuring new guests each week.

title: Cyclicality with Carmen Lorenzana
author: Carmen Lorenzana
description:
Cyclicality with Carmen Lorenzana is a cozy space to understand your menstrual cycle, trust your body’s rhythms, and explore what it means to live in a cyclical body.
Through body literacy, cyclical wisdom, honest conversations and nuanced reflections, we explore what almost no one taught us about our hormones, bodies, and the way our cycles shape our lives. Here, your cycle is not a problem to fix, but a source of information, self-knowledge, care, meaning, and power.
Hosted by Carmen Lorenzana, Menstrual and Fertility Awareness Educator and Cycle Coach.
Welcome to the circle.

title: Mrs. Quiet Comeback
author: Mrs. Quiet Comeback
description:
Mrs. Quiet Comeback is for women 50+ who are quietly rebuilding after burnout, workplace disappointment, major life changes, or seasons that left them wondering what comes next.


This is a space for honest conversations about starting over, protecting your peace, rebuilding confidence, setting higher standards, rediscovering purpose, and creating a life that feels more aligned with who you are now.

Some comebacks are loud. Ours can begin quietly — with one decision, one boundary, one prayer, one cup of tea, and one brave next step.

If you’ve ever felt overlooked, overworked, underestimated, or simply ready for something better, pull up a chair.

Same girl. Higher standards. Brighter days. 💜☕

title: Still the One
author: with David & Samantha Bean
description:
Whether your marriage is thriving or hanging on by a thread, we could all use a little help.


We’re Dave & Samantha Bean, hosts of Still the One Podcast. We’ve been married over 33 years and thought it’d be fun to sit with some of our favorite married couples in their living rooms and talk all things marriage. We find out what’s been working for them throughout the years and what hasn’t. How they get through the hard stuff & what they do to cultivate good times.


We always learn a lot and laugh a lot and hope you will too!

title: Don't Date Murderers
author: Afterlife Story Lab
description:
JoJo Putty has one rule: Everyone is a Psychopath until proven innocent.


Raised to spot danger before it spots her, JoJo has turned a lifetime of hypervigilance into Don’t Date Murderers, a podcast investigating the red flags, bad dates and deeply suspicious behaviour everyone else seems determined to ignore.


With help from her listeners, her relentlessly dating mother, her court-mandated therapist and Phillip, the one man she might actually trust, JoJo sets out to keep people from falling in love with psychopaths, stalkers, liars and killers.


The problem?


JoJo is very good at spotting murderers. Just not the one closest to her.


A darkly funny scripted mystery about dating, danger, and what happens when trusting no one still isn’t enough.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The song4u.us  Podcast | Every Gift Has a Story
author: Mike Dr
description:
Real people. Real gifts. Real songs.

The song4u Podcast is about the gifts people keep. Every episode, we sit down with someone who gave a custom song to a person they love. We hear the story they wrote, the moment the song played, and what the recipient said.


We also talk to songwriters, producers, and the team behind song4u.us. We cover how a personalized song gets made, what makes a story land, and why some gifts get remembered while others end up in a drawer.


If you have ever struggled to find the right gift for someone who has everything, this show is for you.


Custom songs in 2 minutes. Starting at $5.99.

Free 30 second preview before you pay.


Listen at song4u.us

New episodes every week.

title: DeStefano Politics: Point of View Show
author: Kolby DeStefano
description:
DeStefano Politics: Point of View Show is a weekly political podcast where Kolby DeStefano discusses the issues shaping America from his perspective. From Washington, D.C. to North Carolina and local communities, the show covers elections, government, the economy, immigration, constitutional rights, and more. Hear a Republican perspective on today’s biggest issues, why they matter, and what can be done differently.
Politics. America. My Point of View.

title: Encore: Tokio Hotel
author: Tokio Hotel
description: Tokio Hotel: the sound of a generation that polarized an entire nation & still thrills millions today. To mark their new album 'ENCORE', Bill, Tom, Georg & Gustav are finally launching their own podcast. Every Thursday for 12 episodes, the four of them talk about one song from the album at a time, covering burning wings, suffocating contracts, and fan choirs in the rain. Here they share band anecdotes you've never heard before and reveal what the countless press articles were really about back. A must for every fan, and an open door for anyone who wants to become one. Welcome!

title: The 7/50 Podcast
author: The Centre for Constitutional Studies
description: The 7/50 podcast is a new series produced by the Centre for Constitutional Studies, a hub for legal research and public education at the University of Alberta. The series hosts conversations with leading scholars and lawyers about current Canadian constitutional debates, from debates over the balance of power between Canada's federal and provincial governments to debates over how to interpret our Charter of Rights and Freedoms. In this first season of the podcast, we keep things close to our institutional home by reflecting on Alberta's constitutional politics, culminating in a breakdown of some of the ballot questions that will feature in the province's October 2026 referendum.

title: MacBreak Weekly (Audio)

description:
MacBreak Weekly covers all things Apple: Leo, Andy Ihnatko, Jason Snell, and Christina Warren analyze every bit of news from the most interesting company in tech. From AI to Vision Pro, iPad to iPhone, these Apple experts know-all and tell-all.

You can join Club TWiT for $10 per month and get ad-free audio and video feeds for all our shows plus everything else the club offers...or get just this podcast ad-free for $5 per month.

title: Everyday Theology Podcast
author: Claire Pemberton
description:

Sim Funded: The Book, the Strategy, and the Business Behind Getting Funded

What does it actually take to pass a proprietary trading evaluation and become a funded trader?

In this podcast, we take a deep dive into Sim Funded, the book designed to help traders better understand the world of simulated trading, futures evaluations, and proprietary trading firms. Rather than simply focusing on trading strategies, the conversation examines the entire process—from choosing an evaluation and understanding the rules to managing risk, controlling drawdowns, and developing the discipline required to reach a funded account.

We discuss why many traders struggle with prop-firm evaluations, including the tendency to overtrade, take excessive risk, misunderstand drawdown requirements, or approach an evaluation as though it were a conventional brokerage account.

The podcast explores a different perspective: successful evaluation trading requires understanding the structure of the game and developing a repeatable process around it.The episode also explores the evolution of Sim Funded as a business and the lessons learned from working with traders across different proprietary trading platforms.

We discuss how technology, analytics, risk management, and hedging can play a role in helping traders navigate the evaluation process more intelligently.

At its core, Sim Funded is about giving traders a framework for approaching prop-firm evaluations with greater preparation and discipline.

The book is intended for both newer traders trying to understand how the industry works and experienced traders looking for a more systematic way to approach evaluations.

Whether you're curious about becoming a funded trader, have struggled with previous evaluations, or simply want to understand the rapidly changing proprietary trading industry, this conversation provides an inside look at the strategies, risks, and business mechanics behind the Sim Funded approach.

Read the book. Understand the rules. Manage the risk. Get funded.

About SMF Unlocked

SMF Unlocked is the podcast for anyone recruiting, holding, or thinking about taking on an FCA Senior Manager Function. Every episode unpacks a specific part of the Senior Managers and Certification Regime — what a designation like Chair, Chief Risk Officer, Compliance Oversight or MLRO actually requires, how the fit and proper test works in practice, and where boards and firms most often get SMF appointments wrong before it's too late to fix cheaply.

This isn't a regulatory affairs show for compliance academics. It's a practical, direct look at SMF appointments from someone who runs these searches for a living — real patterns from real searches, the questions that actually separate a strong candidate from a risky one, and the mistakes that turn a straightforward appointment into a six-month Form A headache.

About the host

Adrian Lawrence FCA is a Fellow of the ICAEW and founder of SMF Capital, a UK recruitment practice specialising in FCA Senior Manager Function appointments — executive and non-executive. He founded FD Capital in 2018 and has since built out Exec Capital, NED Capital and Accountancy Capital alongside SMF Capital, working with boards, investors and regulated firms across the UK on senior and board-level appointments. He leads every SMF search personally, which is where most of what ends up in this podcast actually comes from.

Who this is for

Board members and non-executive directors navigating a Chair or committee chair appointment. Compliance and financial crime professionals building a case for their next SMF16 or SMF17 role. HR and governance teams trying to work out which designation actually applies to a role they're hiring for. And anyone who's been through an SMF appointment that went sideways and wants to understand why.

New episodes regularly. Subscribe wherever you listen, and find detailed written guides to every SMF designation at smfcapital.co.uk.

description:
Co-Hosts, Open Up: A TMJ Discussion
Dr. Pam Marzban and Dr. Mac Lee team up to bring clarity to one of the most misunderstood pain conditions in healthcare: TMD. Together, they

comprehensive view of TMD to the profession.
Dr. Mac Lee practiced dentistry for 50 years and has dedicated his career to helping patients and professionals understand the true mechanical causes of TMD. His work focuses on the compressed condyle, the displaced disc, and the “TMJ Trifecta” that drives most chronic
jaw and headache pain. He is the author of The TMJ Trifecta and Life-Robbing Pain: TMD.
On their podcast, Open Up: A TMJ Discussion, they break down complex topics in simple terms, share real cases, interview experts, and guide listeners toward better understanding, better questions, and better outcomes.

title: The Flock
author: Gregory  Archer
description:
Ever wanted fresh eggs in your own backyard — but weren't sure where to even start?
The Flock is your complete, week-by-week guide to raising chickens (and eventually ducks, turkeys, quail, and geese) at home, hosted by Dr. Gregory Archer and presented by Texas A&M AgriLife Extension — the same trusted source generations of farmers and homesteaders have turned to for research-backed agricultural guidance.
Most backyard poultry advice online is scattered: a forum post here, a five-minute video there, none of it building on what came before. The Flock is different. Over three full years — 156 weekly episodes — we take you from "should I even do this?" all the way to confidently running a mature, thriving flock, covering every season, every challenge, and every milestone in between.
Why listeners stick with this show:
It's genuinely sequential, not just a topic dump. Episode 1 asks whether backyard poultry is right for you. By episode 52, you've built a coop, survived a winter, collected your first eggs, and learned to read your flock's body language. By year three, you're running a breeding program and maybe even a small egg business. Every episode builds on the last — but you can also drop in anywhere and get real, standalone value.
It's built on real expertise, not recycled internet advice. As part of Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, this show draws on decades of agricultural research and hands-on poultry science — not just one hobbyist's personal experience repackaged as universal truth.
It respects your time. Each episode runs 10–15 minutes — long enough to actually teach you something, short enough to finish over morning coffee or a drive to work.
It doesn't sugarcoat the hard parts. We talk honestly about predator losses, the real cost of getting started, and the emotional weight of hard decisions — because keepers who go in with clear eyes are the ones who stick with this rewarding hobby for the long haul.
What you'll actually learn:
Year One takes you through the fundamentals: navigating local laws and HOA rules before you buy a single chick, choosing breeds suited to your climate and goals, building a predator-proof coop, brooding chicks safely, and managing your flock through a full cycle of seasons — including that first thrilling egg.
Year Two goes deeper: hatching your own chicks, adding new species to your backyard, tackling real health challenges with confidence, and exploring whether a small egg business might be right for you.
Year Three is where it all comes together: intentional breeding programs, true self-sufficiency, advanced flock health, and building something that could become a genuine family legacy — or even a small farm business.
Who this show is for:
Total beginners who've never held a chicken but are curious where their food comes from. Experienced keepers looking to fill real gaps in their knowledge. Anyone drawn to a more self-sufficient, connected way of living. And yes — anyone who's simply charmed by the idea of a backyard full of curious, clucking personalities.
Whether you're standing in a farm store aisle wondering which chicks to pick, three years into keeping and hungry for the advanced stuff, or just poultry-curious and not sure where to begin, The Flock meets you exactly where you are — and walks with you, one practical episode at a time.
New episodes every week. Subscribe now and start your journey with episode one — or jump straight to whatever challenge you're facing today.

description: George Orwell’s *Animal Farm* is a biting political allegory disguised as a simple fable about livestock who overthrow their cruel human farmer to establish a utopian society of equals. Award-winning audio director and producer Polly Thomas and writer Charlotte Delaney have brought together a team of incredible actors to deliver never-before produced or performed Shelagh Delaney play Catch Me Who Can as an audio drama for Thomas Carter Projects. Celebrated actor Rita Tushingham, who made her screen debut in the iconic 1961 film version of A Taste of Honey, is united with Delaney’s work once again alongside award-winning stage and screen actor Toby Jones as Mr. Halliwell, and two extraordinary emerging talents Ivy Sheehan as Hattie and Xavier Moras Spencer as Boy, with original music by Max Delaney. T

 

Catch Me Who Can is a play that asks questions about freedom. It tells the story of Hattie, a teenage girl trying to find her freedom by running away from school and home. Her search, or her desire for escape has a profound influence on her teacher Mr. Halliwell, played by Toby Jones, whose rather cosy life is unsettled by her ‘flight’.

 

Charlotte said:

‘My mum wrote Catch Me Who Can in response to me running away from home for 2 days and nights when I was 14, in 1978 and it imagines my last day ‘on the lam’. My mum never really liked school, and she always understood why I hated it – to have to go to the same place every day for years and years whether you like it or not!!! She liked young people, she listened to them, she got their voices right because she respected them and they made her laugh. Like all my mum’s work, the play’s depth and profundity are achieved through economy and humour, pockets of heartbreak and dialogue that falls easily out of the actors’ mouths.'

title: The Ensemble School: From Solo Teachers to Educator Teams
author: Roger Osorio
description:
*Moving from isolated solo performers to orchestrated educator teams that produce transformative learning experiences.*
For over a century, the industrial school model has forced educators to be solo performers—closing the classroom door each morning to carry the entire academic, behavioral, and emotional load of 30 students alone. The result isn't a failure of teacher resilience; it is a structural failure of design that fuels unprecedented burnout and unsustainable turnover.
The Ensemble School is the blueprint for what comes next.
Hosted by educator, author, and University of Pennsylvania GSE faculty member Roger Osorio, this show explores the national movement to dismantle the "one-teacher, one-classroom" paradigm and replace it with distributed, team-based educator models.
Drawing inspiration from how high-caliber theatrical productions and agile teams coordinate specialized talent, we go behind the scenes with the pioneering superintendents, principals, implementation coaches, and researchers (including Arizona State University’s Next Education Workforce ) who are restructuring schools from the ground up.
Each episode delivers candid, tactical insights into:
* *The Structural Shift:* How to re-engineer master schedules, budgets, and physical spaces to support shared-roster teaching pods.
* *The Cultural Reality:* Managing change-anxiety, building psychological safety, and establishing trust among educator teams.
* *The Policy & Funding Levers:* How school boards, elected officials, and philanthropic foundations can catalyze workforce transformation.
* *The Real-World Outcomes:* What happens to student engagement, equity, and teacher retention when educators finally have an ensemble behind them.
Whether you are a district leader ready to pilot your first team, a policymaker funding workforce innovation, or an educator tired of standing alone, The Ensemble School gives you the field-tested strategies to build a more sustainable, human-centered future for education.

description: Join voice actor and content creator Tawny Platis as she sits down with fellow entertainers to talk about what they actually care about while racing to make as many friendship bracelets as they possibly can in 20 minutes. The best part? Each bracelet made by our celebrity guests is available to purchase by viewers like you, with 100% of the sale proceeds donated to a nonprofit organization of the guest’s choice. Every bracelet has a story, and every bracelet helps a cause.

author: Laurence Seitz
description: A heartwarming mix of stories, songs, and life lessons that inspire kindness, courage, confidence, resilience, and hope in children and families.

title: The Catherine Crowe Library
author: Catherine Crowe
description:
Enter the shadowed world of Catherine Crowe, where drawing rooms conceal mysteries, servants know more than their masters, and the boundary between the seen and unseen is never quite secure.

The Catherine Crowe Library presents her books in full, restoring to life the strange tales, social intrigues, crimes, hauntings, and hidden histories that made Crowe one of the most intriguing literary voices of the nineteenth century.

Come, then, and listen, for there are more things in the quiet house, the darkened chamber, and the human heart than daylight readily reveals.

title: The Tiny Tiki Talk Show
author: Trevor Kelly & Tiki-A-Go-Go
description: Pull up a barstool. The Tiny Tiki Talk Show, presented by Tiki-A-Go-Go, is where host Trevor Kelly chats with the artists, musicians and makers of the tiki world for short, loose, off-the-rails interviews. Rockers, Painters, Carvers, Mug makers — if they're coming to Tiki-A-Go-Go, they're fair game. Small show. Big Fun.

title: Pacesetters Breaking Barriers with Business Brilliance
author: Launchpod Studio
description: Pacesetters examines transformative leaders and organizations that reshaped economic landscapes through bold innovation and strategic vision. Through in-depth analysis and conversations with distinguished entrepreneurs and executives, we explore the historical moments, strategic decisions, and personal philosophies that enabled these figures to transcend industry constraints and establish enduring enterprises. This series combines narrative storytelling with rigorous business analysis to reveal how exceptional individuals navigated complexity, challenged conventional wisdom, and created lasting value in their respective markets.

title: Health Policy Forum: In Conversation
author: Stanford Medicine, Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies, Stanford Health Policy
description: A Stanford Health Policy podcast with faculty, researchers, and policy experts on the questions defining health policy today.

title: In Conversation with Rebekah
author: Dr. Rebekah Louisa Smith
description:
In Conversation with Rebekah is a series hosted by award-winning film festival strategist Dr. Rebekah Louisa Smith, also known as The Film Festival Doctor.
This is an educational podcast designed to help independent creatives build and expand their careers. During each episode Rebekah has in-depth, real, authentic and unfiltered conversations with creators who have shaped the entertainment world to provide you with actionable, practical tools so you can create the career you desire.

title: The Brave Dutch
author: Rhes Low, Jr.
description: During WWII, Lt. John Low, Jr, was shot down over Occupied Holland. He spent 11 months evading capture due to the selfless efforts of the Dutch Underground. “After a 96-hour war, Holland capitulated to Germany in May of 1940, but while the Dutch Government was forced to lay down its arms in the face of Hitler’s mighty armies, the people and underground fought on until they witnessed the defeat of this enemy.”-John Low, JrThanks to Swing Republic for the opening music. title: My Testimony Your Breakthrough Podcast
author: Erica B
description:
Welcome to My Testimony, Your Breakthrough Podcast. 
This podcast is dedicated to encouraging women through real stories of faith, healing, and growth with God. 

My mission is to remind you that your experiences—no matter how difficult—can be used for God’s glory and your purpose.
My prayer is that we grow closer to the Father, walk in freedom, and strengthen our faith together. 

Let’s break chains and grow in Christ.

title: IRVA Aperture Podcast
author: IRVA
description: The IRVA Aperture Podcast is the official podcast of Aperture Magazine, the journal of the International Remote Viewing Association (IRVA). Hosted by Managing Editor Ryan Kralik, each episode goes deep with the researchers, practitioners, and thinkers shaping the field of remote viewing and anomalous cognition — from precognition and consciousness research to the practical application of remote viewing in forecasting, investigation, and beyond.

title: Aperture: AgencyAI
author: Prodigi.team Ltd
description:
There's a lot of news about AI replacing agencies and taking over significant chunks of people's work, so we started asking agency and consultancy leaders what it's really doing in their businesses.

Join David Wain-Heapy and Bachir Smahi as they discuss with their guests where AI is delivering, where it isn’t, and where the obvious wins, like the operational and admin side, still go untouched.

One guest told a story of replacing a multi-million dollar CRM over a weekend. A few have been caught out by token bills they couldn't have predicted. And a worry that keeps surfacing is juniors reaching for a prompt before they've learned the craft underneath it.

If you run an agency or a consultancy, it's a useful way to benchmark yourself against your peers.

Hosted by David Wain-Heapy and Bachir Smahi. Produced by Prodigi.

title: LOOSE BRICKS
author: Jill Woodworth
description:
Send me your story! https://form.jotform.com/vigilantegrit/loosebricks
OR via email: vigilantegrit@proton.me
Ever feel like just another brick in the walls of the system?...Well you're not.
I'm here to help you release the intense horror and frustration you feel during your interactions with a system that does not put humans first!! Welcome to my podcast where I share listener submitted stories about the horrors they've experienced within the "systems of care" that are really not there for us but for the systems themselves!
Submission Guidelines:
*Stories must involve rigid institutions (schools, hospitals, HR, courts, etc.).
*We want stories where you saw the game, refused to fawn, and pushed back. No Active Trauma: We only accept processed narratives. This is for stories that have already been survived.
*We’re looking for dark irony and incompetence—the moments that prove the machine is broken.

All names and locations will be changed to protect your privacy. Bring 'em on! Let's show the world the loose bricks that'll bring down the walls Submit your story to: https://form.jotform.com/vigilantegrit/loo... OR vigilantegrit@proton.me

title: Pride and Prejudice | Audiobook
author: Jane Austen
description:
The most famous novel by Jane Austen.

A story about the daily life of English gentry at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries. The not-so-wealthy Mr. and Mrs. Bennet have quite a problem - the time has come to marry off their five adult daughters. The trouble is, it's not easy to find a suitable candidate in the countryside. However, a glimmer of hope appears when a young and rich bachelor moves into the neighboring estate of Netherfield Park. This news electrifies Mrs. Bennet. An opportunity to establish social relations soon presents itself during a public ball, which the new neighbor attends accompanied by his two sisters, brother-in-law, and his friend, an even wealthier bachelor. 

Can first impressions be deceiving, and can closer acquaintance dramatically change one's opinion of another person? The strength of this story lies in its excellently drawn characters, remarkably accurate observations of human nature, humor, and - of course - love.

title: Strange Devils - Audiobook
author: Cary Trebeaux
description:
A debut novel in audio format; free to all. I plan to publish one chapter per week. The entire project is roughly 30 hours long or 277,000 words. 


Writing for the love of writing. No AI. Ever. 


A grounded fantasy tale with a 19th-century American flavor: religious zealots, mysterious beasts, corrupt politicians, and ruthless capitalists, the unstoppable march of progress and the chaos of war. Multiple plot lines converge over the course of the narrative into the climactic conclusion: 


• Aging lawman Josiah Weaver wiles away his days in a nowhere town along the edge of the mighty Wa’Ta’Noo Desert until his predictable routine is interrupted by the arrival of a curious young paleontologist. Unbeknownst to the Sheriff, this seemingly innocuous development will trigger a series of events with global ramifications. 

• In the uncharted northern wilderness, Reverend Thomas Elm and his band of zealots are building an army. 

• Young vagabond Porter Whitlock seeks to return to the Southern Isles, hoping to reclaim the treasure he’s left behind: a cache of gold bullion and a dark-skinned beauty named Ada. Complicating matters, the former sugar plantation has since fallen to a slave uprising led by George “Thulle” Norfolk. 

• Railroad Tycoon L.P. Klein commands a vast shipping empire. For decades, he has wielded unfathomable power and accumulated immeasurable wealth, but time (and a rapidly changing political landscape) are quickly catching up. 

 

Within this setting, we meet a diverse cast of characters, some wildly fantastic, others based in truth, all trying to make sense of a world hellbent on change. 


Themes: Religion, politics, war, slavery, poverty, aging, inequality, injustice, colonialism.

title: The Heartbreak Chronicles
author: Nessa
description:
Hey Lovelies, 
The Heartbreak Chronicles is a space to talk about love, loss, and everything in between. Whether you are currently in a toxic relationship or stepping out of one and rediscovering yourself, this podcast is for you. Start your healing journey with somebody who is walking with you every step of the way. You are not alone ❤️. 
With Love, 
Nessa

title: The Expert Freedom Show
author: Laura Meyer
description: You've spent 15 or 20 years getting excellent at what you do. The Expert Freedom Show is about what that's worth outside the building. Host Laura Meyer, founder of Expert Freedom, has helped over 10,000 experienced professionals turn what they already know into consulting and advisory businesses, and she runs her own seven-figure business in about 15 hours a week. Every Wednesday: offers, pricing, and clients for women building a freedom-first business on their own terms.
